caption: United States v. Jefferson
citation_line: United States v. Jefferson, No. 1:25-cv-01931, ECF No. 4 (D.N.J. May 20, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Recommended summary enforcement of a False Claims Act civil investigative demand for oral testimony from a former employee of an investigation target. The opinion treated the CID like an administrative subpoena and applied the correspondingly narrow scope of judicial review.
qualification_rationale: A useful public explanation of the federal government's pre-complaint FCA information-gathering power and the respondent's limited grounds for resisting a CID.
appellate_posture_note: R&R with a proposed order appended; no later adoption or substantive appellate review identified through the cutoff.
